method:
Static measurement of install-line pinning, release cadence and tool-definition churn
for popular MCP server npm packages.

SAFETY: this script never executes package code. It reads registry metadata over HTTPS,
downloads published tarballs from the registry's own `dist.tarball` URL and reads the
files inside them as text. No node, no npm install, no npx, no lifecycle scripts.

Reproduce:
    .venv/bin/python scripts/research/npm_tool_churn.py         --as-of 2026-09-29 --out docs/research-data/npm-tool-churn-2026-09-29.json

Method (recorded in the output JSON as well):
  * Package list: official vendor or MCP-project stdio servers on npm, ranked by npm weekly
    downloads for 2026-09-21..27 (api.npmjs.org/downloads/point/last-week). The weekly
    figure is re-fetched at run time and stored beside each package.
  * Install line: every mention of the package in the README published on npm (packument
    `readme` field, i.e. what https://www.npmjs.com/package/<name> shows) that sits on an
    `npx` line or inside a JSON `args` array. Unpinned = no version or `@latest`.
  * Cadence: versions whose publish time in the packument `time` map falls in the 90 days
    before --as-of.
  * Churn: tool definitions statically extracted from the tarball of the current `latest`
    and of the version that was newest on (as-of minus 90 days). A tool is a string-literal
    `name` followed, within the same object, by a string-literal `description`, where the
    object also carries `inputSchema`/`input_schema`/`parameters`/`annotations`/`handler`;
    or a `registerTool("name", {... description ...})` / `.tool("name", "description", ...)`
    call. Descriptions are compared after whitespace normalisation of the first literal.
    Anything not matching is reported as not statically extractable - never guessed.

excluded_from_top30.@storybook/mcp: library consumed by @storybook/addon-mcp; not a server users install with npx
excluded_from_top30.@posthog/mcp: PostHog's MCP analytics/instrumentation SDK (depends on @posthog/core); not a server
excluded_from_top30.mcp-remote: stdio-to-remote proxy, not a server with its own tools
